title: GBPUSD M30 5-Year History Benchmark with Weekly Target Lock Removed
research_question: Does removing the weekly profit target lock (InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0) on the remediated GBPUSD champion configuration allow continuous trading across the full 5-year training history (2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31) and establish a complete multi-year baseline?
hypothesis: Disabling the weekly profit target lock (InpWeeklyTargetPct: 5.0 -> 0.0) on the GBPUSD champion settings (InpLondonOpen=11, InpLondonClose=12, InpNYOpen=13, InpNYClose=18, InpRequire618Rejection=true, InpUseFib382=false, InpTP2Pips=15, InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=20) together with the repaired ResetWeek() calendar logic will remove artificial weekly locks and establish full 5-year trade activity across 2020-2024.

facts: In EXP-0064 (GBPUSD M30 Training 2020-2024), the strategy executed only 31 trades before ceasing on 2022.08.16.
EXP-0064 ran on commit a5461ec prior to the ResetWeek() calendar week index fix (commit 91d075a).
In EXP-0065 (2026 UNSEEN), GBPUSD demonstrated positive expectancy (+$369.98, PF 1.51, WR 61.1%, Max DD 3.23%).
In EXP-0069, disabling InpWeeklyTargetPct (5.0 -> 0.0) unlocked full 5-year continuous execution for EURUSD (+ $1,767.51, PF 1.27, 179 trades).
inferences: Setting InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0 completely bypasses [G3] Weekly profit lock (if(InpWeeklyTargetPct > 0)), preventing any weekly lockout.
Testing with InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0 across 2020-2024 will provide the true unthrottled 5-year historical trade distribution and resilience for GBPUSD.
evidence: EXP-0064 deal history shows trading halted on 2022.08.16 with total_trades=31.
EXP-0069 confirmed InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0 allows uninterrupted execution across all 5 years.

independent_variables.name: InpWeeklyTargetPct
independent_variables.rationale: Disables the weekly profit lock guard, ensuring uninterrupted trading every week throughout 2020-2024 without artificial weekly halts.

assumptions: The 5-year tick and bar data for GBPUSD M30 is intact (99%+ history quality) across 2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31.
Removing the weekly target lock allows trade frequency to reflect true market conditions rather than arbitrary weekly cutoffs.
expected_observations: Total trades will be substantially higher than 31.
Trading execution across 2020-2024 without artificial weekly target lockouts.
falsification_conditions: Total trades remain <= 31 (indicating trading lock or premature halt).
